market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI near $106 with today's high already $110.90; EIA forecasts Q2 peak ~$115. Touching $120 by end of June requires another ~13% upside from current — plausible if Hormuz remains shut and conflict escalates, but not the base case in EIA's central forecast. Moderate odds.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Hormuz reopens vs further escalation pushing oil into the $120s
